text:
sarah_oncall: Heads-up: starting 09:47 UTC we've seen an increase in tail latency for eu1 hosted inference; p95 jumped above 850ms for a subset of requests. No large-scale 5xx spike, but customer experience degraded. Investigating now. Status: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2801240123

kevin_infra: I'm looking at scheduler and node health. Early signs point to prolonged sequences from a handful of customers + KV cache churn causing more cache misses and CPU fallback.

ops-bot: alert: eu1-serving-pool: p95=870ms, inflight=2100, queue_depth=380, avg_batch=2.8 -> 09:52:04 UTC

marta_prod: Can we throttle extremely long requests temporarily and enable fallback to a lower-memory quant variant? We should prepare a short customer note.

sarah_oncall: Action: temporary policy applied -> limit requests > 8k tokens to 2 rps for free tier; enabled automatic fallback route to gptx-lite for sequences > 2048 tokens. Also paused scheduled background evals in eu1. Monitoring impact.

liam_support: Noted. I'll flag customers with >1s p95 in last hour so CS can preemptively message them.

ops-bot: logs excerpt (09:50:12 UTC):
```
[worker-03] KV_CACHE_EVICT key=session-42 size=12MB
[worker-03] kernel_fallback: slow_path_ms=15.8
[worker-11] request token_len=11000 batch_size=1
```

kevin_infra: Proposed infra mitigation: prefer fused-kernel path on eu1-serving-pool-2 nodes. Requires rolling restart (canary 2 nodes, then 1-by-1). Roughly 8-10m. Josh, can research confirm kernel change is safe?

sarah_oncall: Approve canary restart. Prioritize non-dedicated nodes.

ops-bot: rolling restart started at 09:56 UTC. Canary nodes up at 10:02 UTC.

ops-bot: metric update (10:04 UTC): p95 -> 320ms, queue_depth -> 120, inflight -> 1.1k

kevin_infra: Canary performance looks good; proceeding with remainder of pool. Health checks 30s per node.

marta_prod: Drafting customer-facing blurb: 'We observed increased response times in EU hosted inference. We applied temporary rate limits and a fallback model variant; rolling infra fixes are in progress. No customer requests were dropped. We'll update in 30 minutes or when resolved.'

liam_support: Sending proactive messages to affected accounts now.

ops-bot: metric update (10:16 UTC): p95 230ms, queue_depth 60, inflight 720

sarah_oncall: Service p95 stabilized around 200-260ms at 10:18 UTC following kernel preference change and rate limits. No customer-facing errors introduced.

kevin_infra: Rolling restart completed at 10:19 UTC. Monitoring for 30m.

statusbot: Incident created INC-2026-2801240123 -> https://internal.ops.redwood/INC-2026-2801240123

liam_support: CS to follow up with any customers that report regressions.

sarah_oncall: Closing broadcast: mitigation successful; incident moved to monitoring/resolved. We'll open a postmortem to address KV eviction tuning and a more graceful kernel-selection path. Expect draft PM in 48 hours.

statusbot: INC-2026-2801240123 status: Resolved at 10:20 UTC (duration 00:33:00).
